acceptance_criteria: 本番データを使わない
scope: scripts/staging_trial.py runs inside one new staging directory with synthetic data only: the real MCP server over stdio with a staging ledger and a fresh environment (no host credential reaches it), the external tool against an in-memory destination, the kill switch, a backup and restore and the monitor. It refuses a host ledger outside the staging directory and leaves it untouched; the repository and the operator's home are not written. CI runs it in the locked environment.
